sourceTitle: The Gospel of Evolution From "The Atheistic Platform", Twelve Lectures
description: "The Gospel of Evolution" by Edward B. Aveling is a scientific publication written in the late 19th century. This work critiques traditional religious beliefs, particularly Christianity, presenting evolution as a new "gospel" that offers a more accurate and scientifically grounded understanding of the universe and humanity's place within it.
